name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 1 – Am 58
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 1a. Pays solemn tribute to all victims of Islamist terrorism, as well as to the growing number of politicians, academics, journalists and public figures who are forced to live under permanent police protection simply for having exposed the reality of Islamist entryism and the subversive nature of these networks;
